subject: Post-discovery: schedule Private VPC architecture review (next steps)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Amy Bennett <amy.bennett@greenridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: next step — Private VPC architecture review

Hi Amy — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Greenridge Health has a strong requirement for VPC-isolated inference, customer-managed KMS, and the expectation of an on-prem option for certain regulated workflows. You flagged the audit log and retention policies as gating items for procurement.

Next step I'd recommend is a focused architecture review (technical deep-dive) with our infra lead to walk through: network connectivity options (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink), KMS integration patterns, and deployment footprint estimates for an initial pilot. That will let us produce a rough cost/ops plan and a mutual action plan for procurement.

Proposed 30–45 minute windows (in your timezone):
- Wed Oct 7 — 10:00–10:45 AM ET
- Thu Oct 8 — 2:00–2:45 PM ET

If neither works, share a couple slots and we'll align. I attached the signed NDA and our Private Deploy checklist (high level) so you can circulate with your security/compliance team.

Attaching: NDA_signed.pdf, redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf

Thanks — I'll hold the two windows temporarily.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
